authority: AI-assisted implementation under continuing author instruction; not author-self writing or human review
lesson_source: User direction after L4.7 and PHASE_4_v2 roadmap; no full L4.8 lesson supplied

use_case.working_narrative: DC-inspired one-shot steering of a managed traffic aggregate between two equal-capacity egress queues, using a twin to compare Stay and Switch over a fixed horizon
use_case.purpose: Controlled study of state/model information value, not a validated deployed SDN/TCP/flowlet controller
use_case.context_a: Focus narrative within previously authorized DC context; 10 Gb/s is documented in ZLK17 section4.2, PDF3
use_case.context_b: Existing edge10-100Mb/s context/envelope v1 retained; not reclassified or claimed validated

model_domain.current_native_supported_subset_extra: lambdaB+u < 10; implementation restriction, not physical validity
model_domain.numerical_admissibility: h*120*ref integer at selected positive integer ref; no silent ceil
model_domain.exposure: Existing supports were selected during discovery; this scope document is after those outcomes, not an independent preregistration

fixed_assumptions: Two disjoint infinite-buffer queues with equal service and unweighted total-backlog endpoint cost
Exogenous symmetric two-level Markov background, amplitude/capacity=0.6
Stationary pre-Stay P1; managed load moves instantly and remains fixed over h
S0 true/shared posterior from old backlog; M0 conditional mean rollout per current state
S1 observes hidden modes as an oracle benchmark, not deployable fresh telemetry
M1 knows the cost law, not realized future; strict negative gap Switch, ties Stay

illustrative_projection_only.origin: Reuse legacy DC capacity/context and 10ms illustrative age anchor; tau is not an empirical backlog-age measurement
illustrative_projection_only.model_backlog_unit: Fluid work quantity; not a physical packet of a fixed byte size
